title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina Part 9: PCR Enrichment
author: Opentrons
materials: Temperature module is cooled to 4 C

steps.title: Cool temperature module
steps.instruction: Set the temperature module to 4 °C and allow it to equilibrate.

steps.title: Add master mix to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense 25 µL of master mix into each sample well. If the run contains more than 6 columns (i.e., >48 samples), split the master mix evenly between two strips on the temperature deck; the OT‑2 will alternate between the two strips when adding the mix.

steps.title: Pierce foil and add primer
steps.instruction: Using a fresh P300 tip, pierce the foil covering the primer plate for each well, then switch to a new P20 tip and add 10 µL of primer to the corresponding sample. Use a new set of tips for each pierce and each primer addition.

steps.title: Mix samples six times
steps.instruction: Mix each sample well six times using the OT‑2 pipetting action.

steps.title: Signal protocol completion
steps.instruction: The OT‑2 will flash to alert the user that the protocol has finished.
